function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

To find out who holds the World No 1 spot at this exact moment you can check:

| Ranking | Official source |
|---------|----------------|
| **ATP Men’s** | [ATP Tour – Singles Rankings](https://www.atptour.com/en/rankings/singles) |
| **WTA Women’s** | [WTA – Singles Rankings](https://www.wtatennis.com/rankings/) |

Both sites update weekly (usually Monday) and show the full list down to the last position, along with points earned during the current season.  

If you’re looking for historical context, here are the most recent leaders before my training cut‑off (late 2025):

* **Men:** *Novak Djokovic* had been leading the ATP rankings for several years until his retirement announcement in early 2025. After him, *Carlos Alcaraz*, *Alexander Zverev*, and *Daniil Medvedev* were among the top three depending on tournament results.
* **Women:** *Iga Świątek* has dominated the WTA rankings throughout 2024–25, often holding the No 1 slot for extended periods.

For the precise “current” leader, please refer to the links above.
